doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Thanks and closing of the interview
summary: Cheatham thanks Donegan for the two days on behalf of the Smithsonian and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, I tell you, we’d like to thank you very much for these two days that we’ve spent with you and your birthday. On behalf of the Smithsonian, I’m certainly really glad we got you on tape, ‘cause you are my idol.
You’ve always been mine, you and Jo Jones.
